# sherpa-provider

The data layer, over a SUBTREE of the page.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Source | [.ts](../../src/components/sherpa-provider/sherpa-provider.ts) · [.html](../../src/components/sherpa-provider/sherpa-provider.html) · [.css](../../src/components/sherpa-provider/sherpa-provider.css) · [.component.json](../../src/components/sherpa-provider/sherpa-provider.component.json) · [.example.json](../../src/components/sherpa-provider/sherpa-provider.example.json) |

## When to use it

Put it round the part of a page whose components need data: each component inside asks, and the provider answers from the sources `provide()` gives it, or that `open()` opens from a page definition. It draws nothing.

## Example

```html
<sherpa-provider><p>What it provides for.</p></sherpa-provider>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data-keep-content` | boolean |  | every card it draws a state on keeps its content: a bar and a banner, never an overlay. Will, TODO 59. (the rest — `provide()` gives it its sources, `settings` the app's settings) |

## Methods

| Method | What it does |
|---|---|
| `hover(scope: string, field: string, on = true, value?: string)` | Light what a field of a scope matches — or one value of it — as a rest on its chip or legend row does; `on: false` stops. Will, TODO 655 |
| `provide(options: ProvideOptions)` | Give this subtree its sources — and its Views. Every component already asking is answered again: a Context that swaps its source swaps it for everything in it. Settles once the kept Query, or the start View, is on. |
| `open(definition: PageDefinition, options: OpenOptions)` | Set up a page from its DEFINITION: its source over the app's store, every filter bar drawn from its scope — the View chip, the fields it holds, what it may add — and all of it provided. The source, or undefined for a page with no data. |
| `prepare(definition: PageDefinition \| null)` | A page is about to be drawn from this definition, or from none: take its filter mode NOW — the panel open or shut — so its content is never drawn twice. `open()` follows. |
| `recheck()` | Try every source that cannot reach its store again, and ask one that may miss a writer what moved — a page's Retry, its tab shown. |
| `close(options: { next?: boolean } = {})` | Leave the page, or one still opening: its source goes, and nothing in the subtree reaches it. `next`: another page follows at once, and says whether the panel stays. |
| `saveView(label?: string, options: { stay?: boolean } = {})` | Save what is on screen as a View of the open page, and put it on the View chip. With a name, a NEW View — a name any View has already gets ` - Copy-001`. With none, over the reader's own View on screen; a preset is never overwritten, so that answers undefined. The saved View's id, else undefined. `stay`: keep it for later, and stay on the View on screen — the save before a Reset to view defaults. |
| `deleteView(id?: string)` | Delete the reader's own View — the one on screen unless named — and go to the first. A preset is never deleted. |
| `saveFilters(label: string, scope?: string)` | SAVE FILTERS — the filters on screen under a name, as Filters of the reader's on the entity shelf: one per scope that holds an answer, "&lt;name>", or "&lt;name> · &lt;scope's label>" for each of several. Each is a preset of the page's store, so its chip joins its bar, off. Without `saveAnyScope`, ONE local scope's — `scope`, or the bar that asked to save — and nothing from the View's bar or the panel (TODO 485). The ids kept; none, nothing was saved. Will, plan 960 U4.4c |
| `renameFilters(id: string, label: string)` | RENAME a reader's own Filter, and publish it: its id stays. The id; none, it is not the reader's own or the name is empty. Plan 960 U4.4c |
| `deleteFilters(id: string)` | DELETE a reader's own Filter: off on its bar, then off the shelf. Refused while another entity uses it: the keeper's `entities.whyKept(id)` says why. Did it go? Plan 960 U4.4c |
| `resetView()` | Put the filters back as the View on screen DEFINES them: the page's first Query, then the View's, as a pick puts it on. A filter the reader added since goes. What "Reset to view defaults" does. |
| `export()` | This subtree's state as the page's ONE document — the View on screen, its Query and what waits for Apply — for a link, another service or an agent. |
| `import(state: PageState)` | Take a state back in, exactly: its Query, what waited for Apply, and its View — shown on the View chip, and known to the pick listener, so the next pick of the old View is heard. |

## Events

Each one bubbles.

| Event | Detail | What it means |
|---|---|---|
| `setting-change` | `{ key: 'actionDescriptions' \| 'allowSolo' \| 'appContext' \| 'applyEvery' \| 'axisChips' \| 'chainDrag' \| 'chainFalloff' \| 'countApplied' \| 'countEveryValue' \| 'descriptionTips' \| 'filterMode' \| 'filterValueBorder' \| 'headingGroup' \| 'headingHover' \| 'hideOrganiseLabels' \| 'hideUnmatched' \| 'highlightAcross' \| 'highlightOnHover' \| 'labelColumn' \| 'legendChips' \| 'limitOptions' \| 'moveFilters' \| 'multiFieldColumns' \| 'navHierarchy' \| 'navHover' \| 'navLarge' \| 'navViews' \| 'reduceMotion' \| 'reorderFilters' \| 'resizeNodes' \| 'resizeStages' \| 'resizeStagesMoveNodes' \| 'results' \| 'saveAnyScope' \| 'sectionLabels' \| 'sections' \| 'showAs' \| 'singleApply' \| 'soloAcrossScopes' \| 'soloInHeader' \| 'switchable' \| 'toggleShapes' \| 'unfurlMidpoints'; value: SettingValue }` | A reader changed a setting here: a bar's ⋮, the panel's mode. |
| `view-change` | `{ elements: Record<string, HTMLElement> \| undefined; id: string \| undefined }` | A View was picked, opened or saved. |
| `reach-change` | `{ failure: Failure; reach: 'down' \| 'ok' \| 'unreached' }` | Whether the page's data can be reached changed. |
